maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring broadband, voice and video subscriptions from rural customers, not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Most revenue is subscriber billing to residential and business customers; federal support programs (USF/ETC) are a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: 38 acquisitions over many years, but growth is mainly network buildout and broadband subscriber growth, with M&A one of three pillars.

mission_critical.reason: Incumbent carrier for rural territories providing broadband, voice and 911 services; customers have few alternatives and switching is disruptive.

notes: Share of revenue from government support programs is not stated on the website text.
